overall_verdict_rationale:
Hedge does not produce defense-like regime asymmetry. Across all 3 tuple axes:
  (1) crisis_alpha: hedge variants WORSEN CRISIS regime SR (S1 +0.018 → FH -0.123 → M4+FH -0.160)
  (2) Core MDD pp improvement: post-cost only -0.51pp (FH) and -1.75pp (M4+FH) vs spec -3pp target; pre-cost -7.89pp WORSE than L-274 reference
  (3) bad/normal ratio: CAUTION ratio improves but CRISIS ratio TURNS NEGATIVE (-0.117 FH / -0.153 M4+FH)
The CAUTION-regime improvement is real (+0.22 SR FH, +0.22 M4+FH vs S1 baseline) but is dominated by CRISIS deterioration in AX-001 v2 conditional evaluation. AX-001 v2 explicitly requires bad/normal IC (or SR by analogy) ratio to demonstrate defense — a negative CRISIS ratio invalidates the defense claim.
